name: homebrew-manager
title: Homebrew
description: Install, uninstall (with --zap), and upgrade Homebrew packages, auto-trusting taps when Homebrew asks for it.
author: nyaran2910

commands.name: install
commands.title: Brew Install
commands.description: Search formulae/casks and install them (auto-trusts required taps)

commands.name: uninstall-zap
commands.title: Brew Uninstall (Zap)
commands.description: Uninstall casks with --zap, removing their app data too

commands.name: upgrade
commands.title: Brew Upgrade
commands.description: Upgrade outdated packages, one at a time or all at once

commands.name: trust-taps
commands.title: Brew Trust Taps
commands.description: Show tapped repositories and trust or untrust them

commands.name: copy-last-error
commands.title: Copy Last Brew Error
commands.description: Copy the error message of the last failed brew command

preferences.name: autoTrust
preferences.title: Tap Trust
preferences.label: Automatically trust taps when Homebrew asks for it
preferences.description: When brew says a tap must be trusted, run `brew trust` and retry automatically.

preferences.name: trustScope
preferences.title: Auto-Trust Scope
preferences.description: Trust the whole tap, or only the specific formula/cask being loaded.

preferences.name: copyErrorOnFailure
preferences.title: Errors
preferences.label: Copy the error to the clipboard automatically on failure
preferences.description: Otherwise use the Copy Last Brew Error command or the toast action.
